title: PreferenceScene: Personalized Indoor Scene Synthesis from Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2611.32099v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-scene methods turn a short instruction into a furnished 3D room, but the room that a particular person wants rarely comes across fully in words: many preferences surface only when the person sees a concrete room and can point to what they like and dislike in it. We therefore study personalized indoor scene synthesis under hidden user preferences: over several turns, a system shows a 3D scene, and the user, who sees only rendered images of the scene, replies with brief free-form feedback and a satisfaction score. The system must therefore bring the whole room toward the user's preferences from feedback that comments on only part of it at a time. translated_title: PreferenceScene：基于反馈的个性化室内场景合成
translated_abstract: 文本到场景方法能够将简短的指令转化为布置好家具的3D房间，但某个人真正想要的房间很少能通过文字完整表达：许多偏好只有在人们看到具体房间并能指出其中喜欢和不喜欢之处时才会显现出来。因此，我们研究了用户隐藏偏好条件下的个性化室内场景合成问题：在多轮交互中，系统展示一个3D场景，用户仅通过查看场景的渲染图像，以简短的自由形式反馈和满意度评分进行回复。因此，系统必须从每次仅针对房间部分内容的反馈中，将整个房间逐步调整到符合用户偏好。系统还必须能够改变房间的每一处细节，因为用户的偏好不仅涉及单个物体，还涉及表面材质、光照、纺织品、家具及其布局共同营造的整体外观与氛围。我们提出了PreferenceScene，其中大语言模型保持……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出PreferenceScene，通过多轮交互中用户对场景渲染图像的简短自由反馈和满意度评分，利用大语言模型从局部反馈中推断并追踪用户的隐藏偏好，实现整体个性化室内3D场景合成。
en_tdlr: PreferenceScene enables personalized indoor 3D scene synthesis by using a large language model to infer users' hidden preferences from iterative, brief free-form feedback and satisfaction scores on rendered scenes, adjusting every aspect of the room accordingly.
